strategies.name: first_candle_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high/low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle, switch to the 1-minute chart, wait for price to break the level and form a fair value gap, then wait for price to retest the FVG and for that retest candle to be engulfed before entering long (after a bullish break through the 5
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop under the lowest area traded into the FVG with one tick of breathing room. Take profit at a fixed 3:1 R multiple and then let the trade play out without micromanaging it.

variants.timeframe_note: 5-minute chart for the opening candle, then 1-minute chart for direction confirmation
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for the retest candle to get engulfed after the market trades back into the FVG
variants.transcript_quote: we're going to wait for this retest candle right here to get engulfed... and then for our takerit, we are just targeting a fixed 3:1 return

strategies.name: first_candle_fvg_limit_entry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high/low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle, switch to the 5-minute chart, wait for a fair value gap formed from the first candle, and place a limit order directly on the FVG so that the market automatically enters when it trades back into the gap.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop right under the first candle in the FVG pattern. Take profit at a fixed 2:1 R multiple and do not micromanage the position even if price revisits the fair value gap.

variants.timeframe_note: 15-minute chart for the opening candle, then 5-minute chart for the FVG setup
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: set a limit order on the FVG instead of waiting for a retest and engulfing candle
variants.transcript_quote: instead of waiting for a retest, we're actually going to set a limit order on the FVG... we are going to target a fixed 2:1 return

enumeration_note: Two distinct strategies are taught: a scalp entry and a day-trade entry. They share the same broad first-candle/FVG idea but differ in entry logic and target/management, so they are separate objects.
